# Persistence, Transform, and Profile Availability

| Surface | Approved boundary | r0.2 availability/action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Persisted ensemble | ODQ-109 approved plan-selected exact member persistence. | Available only under an exact plan declaring reconstruction, lifecycle, failure, and completion. |
| Compact deterministic regeneration | ODQ-109 approved plan-selected regeneration. | Available only with exact generator/key/parent/operator identity and numerical-regeneration promise. |
| Streaming sufficient statistics | ODQ-109 approved plan-selected streaming. | Available only with exact retained sufficiency and explicit unavailable later questions. |
| Composite persistence | More than one mode is a distinct plan. | No implicit composition or fallback. |
| Deterministic transform | ODQ-110A requires external owner authority and exact parity. | Numerical route unavailable until all required operator facts are exact. |
| Wiener | ODQ-110B preserves fixed versus learned/selected generations. | Base numerical transformed route unavailable; learning/selection creates new applicable generations and never mixes. |
| FRUIT | ODQ-110C preserves fixed versus learned/continued/replayed generations. | Base numerical transformed route unavailable; learning/continuation/replay creates new applicable generations and never mixes. |
| GEN-input profile | ODQ-111 owner-approved and registered under exact r0.18 bytes. | Immutable r0.18 action preserved; r0.2 changed bytes require successor binding. |
| UNC-member profile | Same. | Same; consumes but does not redefine GEN facts. |
| UNC-ensemble profile | Same. | Same; admits one exact complete ensemble but does not realize estimator. |
| STD-admission profile | Same. | r0.2 changed STD notation/action bytes; evaluation unavailable until successor approval/binding. |

The exact process bindings are reported in
`SOURCE_AND_PROFILE_BINDING_REPORT.md`. They verify authority but author no NOI
science.
